Container.Name: Sonneck

Branch.TagDescription: beta: the newest pre-release, or the stable release when it's newer; may have rough edges
dev: a nightly build of the newest tested commit on main; not stable, may break, a lot of changes per update

Container.Overview: An intuitive sheet music organizer, made by a musician for musicians. Import, tag, search and download pieces and whole books of sheet music (a built-in book splitter turns one PDF into its pieces), practice and perform from a full-screen sheet viewer with annotations, a metronome and a Practice List, and plan setlists with one combined PDF. Important: Sonneck first starts with no password. Open the web UI right away and choose a sign-in method on the setup screen (or set Sign-in method below) before exposing it to your network.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: sheet music scores pdf library setlist practice musician

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Everything Sonneck keeps: the database, your PDFs and covers, backups and logs. To use an existing Sonneck library, point this at it.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: The user Sonneck runs as. The library folder is created for, and owned by, this user.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: The group Sonneck runs as. The library folder is created for, and owned by, this group.

Config.Name: Sign-in method
Config.Description: Optional: none, singlepass (one password) or oidc (sign in with SSO). Leave on the blank choice to pick on the first-launch setup screen; any other choice locks it. See the README's Security options.

Config.Name: Copyright region
Config.Description: Optional: which public-domain rule the Likely Public Domain badge uses (en-US when blank). The blank choice leaves it editable in Admin Settings.

Config.Name: Backup schedule
Config.Description: Optional. A cron expression for the daily database backup (0 3 * * * when blank: 3am in Unraid's time zone). Blank leaves it editable in Admin Settings.

Config.Name: Backup retention (days)
Config.Description: Optional. Backups and logs older than this are deleted (30 when blank). Blank leaves it editable in Admin Settings.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Optional: how much Sonneck logs (info when blank). The blank choice leaves it editable in Admin Settings.

Config.Name: Behind an HTTPS proxy
Config.Description: true only if a reverse proxy in front of Sonneck terminates HTTPS; marks sign-in cookies Secure.

Config.Name: SSO issuer URL
Config.Description: For Sign-in method oidc: your identity provider's base URL. See docs/oidc-setup.md.

Config.Name: SSO client ID
Config.Description: For Sign-in method oidc: this app's client ID at your identity provider.

Config.Name: SSO client secret
Config.Description: For Sign-in method oidc: this app's client secret at your identity provider.

Config.Name: SSO redirect URI
Config.Description: For Sign-in method oidc: the full callback URL, e.g. https://sonneck.example.com/api/auth/oidc/callback, exactly as registered with your provider.

Config.Name: SSO button name
Config.Description: Optional, for oidc: the name on the Sign in with... button (your identity provider when blank).

Config.Name: SSO allow registration
Config.Description: For oidc: true gives first-time sign-ins an account; false rejects them until an admin links them.

Config.Name: SSO default permissions
Config.Description: Optional, for oidc: comma-separated permissions for new accounts (read when blank): read, download, practice, edit, upload, create, delete, admin.
